resources.string: Choose a mode, connect and review authorization
Choose explicitly. Selecting a mode does not grant privileges or start the embedded service. You can cancel and choose later in settings.
Requires the external official Shizuku app, a running service and permission for TensorIMS.
Private service for TensorIMS. Requires independent wireless debugging pairing or existing root access.

Configuration history, drafts and original-value backups in this app are kept. The idle, verified private service is stopped when leaving embedded mode; the official service is never stopped. Selection alone does not activate privileges.
An operation or recovery is in progress. Try switching after it finishes; this switch will not be queued.

The last operation or its cleanup is unconfirmed. Do not repeat writes. Keep all app data and original-value backups. Refresh to check completion; if needed, reboot the device. Reconnect only when this page offers it after confirming the old task has ended, then verify system values before making further changes.
Start Shizuku in the official app, return here and refresh. If permission was denied, only a new explicit permission request retries it.

On this device, enable Wireless debugging in Developer options. Use “Pair device with pairing code” for the pairing port and six-digit code. The connection port is separate and may change. Pairing does not start the service.
Developer options could not be opened. Open Android Settings manually.
Requires existing root and approval from your root manager. Starts only the TensorIMS private service when you press the button.
Connecting to local ADB and verifying service…
Pairing completed. Enter the connection port to start the service.
This action continues if you leave this page. Reopening the page or rotating the device will not start it again.

This is a separate app and does not inherit old private data. First disable auto-restore in the old app and use it to restore persistent VoLTE original values for every modified SIM, including currently inactive SIMs. Keep the old app and its data until restoration and the new app are verified. Never enable auto-restore in both apps at once. Uninstalling or clearing the old app removes its recovery backups.
Auto-apply when the selected backend is ready

Off by default. Applies saved configurations after the selected backend is ready and authorized. Does not pair, request root, start a service or change wireless debugging settings. Persistent VoLTE is not included.
Connect and authorize the selected backend first
Official Shizuku is unavailable. Start it in the official app, then refresh.
Official permission has not been granted. You can request it again.
Pairing is required or was revoked. Pair this app again.
The service identity or version could not be verified. Privileged operations are blocked.
Another privileged operation is using system delegation. Wait for it to finish, then retry.
The current system or device does not support this capability.
Restore original values from the last operation?

This restores persistent VoLTE original values saved by the last operation. It does not replay the enable operation. Continue only after the previous operation has ended and the same SIM has been verified. Keep the app and its backups until recovery is confirmed.
Restoring saved original values and verifying…
No SIM information is available. Connect and authorize the selected backend, then refresh.
Takes effect immediately for this SIM. On compatible devices and carriers, VoLTE remains usable after a normal restart without starting a privilege service or opening TensorIMS.

This only preserves VoLTE settings. Other saved IMS configurations still need the selected backend to be ready before they can be applied again after a restart. Actual calls depend on the device, carrier and network.
New app identity: keep the old app and its recovery backups. Disable its auto-restore and restore persistent VoLTE original values there before using this app.
Reload the current system values and replace the unsaved input. Cancel to keep your draft.
Could not read Captive Portal settings. Your unsaved input has been kept.
The save result could not be confirmed. Keep your draft and check the backend status before retrying.
The SIM read did not return a confirmed result.
Showing the last successfully read SIM list. Your selection and unsaved configuration have been kept.
